zh-Hant.title: 設計一個溫度提醒

This is a model-room alert exercise; it does not control real devices.
Rule: alert at 28°C or above; process each reading once; mark missing temperatures “to confirm”.
Readings in order: E01 = 27°C, E02 = 28°C, E03 = 29°C, E04 = missing, E02 = 28°C (received again).
en.prompt: For each reading, list its ID, whether it triggers an alert, and why. Give the total number of alerts.
steps: Select “Copy material and request” below.
Paste into a new AI conversation and send.
Return and check the points below. Ask AI to correct any errors.

independent.task: For each reading, decide whether to alert and explain why. Count the alerts.
independent.expected: H02 and H03 alert once each: 2 total. H01, H04, and the repeated H02 add no alerts.
independent.source:
Alert at 70% humidity or above; process each reading once; do not alert for missing data.
In order: H01 = 69%, H02 = 70%, H03 = 71%, H04 = missing, H02 = 70% (repeated).

challenge.source: Three distinct readings: 10:00 = 28°C, 10:03 = 29°C, 10:05 = 28°C. No alerts were sent before these.

challenge.expected: Alert at 10:00, not at 10:03, and again at 10:05 when five minutes have passed. Total: 2.

checks: 28°C triggers an alert; 27°C does not.
Receiving E02 again does not add another alert.
Missing data is not 0°C. The total is 2 alerts.

quiz.question: What should happen when the temperature is missing?
choices: Mark it to confirm and do not alert
Treat it as 0°C and skip it
quiz.explanation: Missing data is not 0°C, and it does not prove that the alert condition has been met.

en.outcome: 27°C: no alert. 28°C and 29°C: one each. Missing: to confirm. A repeated reading: no extra alert.
en.why: Before automating a reminder, spell out when it should and should not happen.

followup.prompt: Change the rule to “alert only above 28°C”. Start from zero and process the same readings again.
followup.expected: 27°C and 28°C do not alert. 29°C alerts once. Missing or repeated readings do not add alerts.

zh-Hant.source: 虛構通知L1：『社團體驗日』活動於2026/11/21 09:00（Asia/Taipei）在雲樓A室舉行；費用每人300 TWD；請於2026/11/18 18:00（Asia/Taipei）前回覆參加；材料另計，價格未定。活動與場地無核准英文名稱。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請把下方資訊寫成中文與英文短通知，讓參加者快速看到時間、地點、費用與回覆期限。活動與場地名稱保留原文；材料另計也要保留。
steps: 按下方「複製資料與要求」。
貼到 AI 的新對話，送出。
回來核對下方重點；有錯就請 AI 修正。
zh-Hant.expected: 中文：『社團體驗日』11/21 09:00於雲樓A室舉行，每人300 TWD；請於11/18 18:00前回覆。日期皆2026年，時間皆Asia/Taipei；材料另計、價格待確認。英文：Join 社團體驗日 at 雲樓A室 on 2026/11/21 at 09:00 (Asia/Taipei), 300 TWD per person. Reply by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei). Materials cost extra; the price is unconfirmed. 核對：兩版六欄一致，沒有新造官方名稱。

independent.task: 寫一份簡短中英文通知。兩種語言的資訊相同，保留原活動名稱，缺資料不要猜。
independent.expected: 中文保留12/03 15:00、B室、免費、12/01 12:00登記期限、材料未知。英文可寫：紙上散步 is at Room B on 2026/12/03 at 15:00 (Asia/Taipei), free of charge. Register by 2026/12/01 12:00 (Asia/Taipei). Materials provision is unconfirmed. 不把免費延伸成含材料。
independent.source:
活動：紙上散步，2026/12/03 15:00，B 教室，免費。
報名截止：2026/12/01 12:00。以上為台北時間。
是否提供材料：待確認。活動名稱沒有官方英文名。

challenge.source: 虛構通知L1：『社團體驗日』活動於2026/11/21 09:00（Asia/Taipei）在雲樓A室舉行；費用每人300 TWD；請於2026/11/18 18:00（Asia/Taipei）前回覆參加；材料另計，價格未定。活動與場地無核准英文名稱。
challenge.prompt: 把資料改成能念給同學聽的中英文簡介。每種語言用三到四句；保留所有已知資訊與待確認事項。
challenge.expected: 兩種語言都能自然念出；活動日期、時間、地點、費用、截止時間與未知材料費一致。

checks: 兩版活動日、回覆期限與300 TWD／人的金額一致。
材料仍是另計、價格未定，不變成已包含材料。
活動與場地名稱保留原文，完整通知保留Asia/Taipei時區。

quiz.question: L1英文版可以說材料已包含嗎？
choices: 不行；來源說另計且價格未定
quiz.explanation: 改寫可以縮短措辭，不能更改包含範圍。

zh-Hant.outcome:
11/21 09:00一起參加「社團體驗日」，每人300 TWD。
Join 社團體驗日 on 11/21 at 09:00; 300 TWD per person.
（節錄；完整通知另含回覆期限與材料說明）
zh-Hant.why: 把同一場活動說給不同語言的朋友，調整說法也要保住事實。

classroom.task: 使用下方預備結果，自己決定改一處、動手修改，再說明怎麼檢查。可以從第 2 步的修改開始。
classroom.expected: 只改語氣與句子長度；兩種語言的活動資訊仍一致。

followup.prompt: 中文改得親切一點，英文用短句。日期、地點、費用與待確認事項都要保留。
followup.expected: 只改語氣與句子長度；兩種語言的活動資訊仍一致。

en.title: Introduce an event in two languages
en.goal: Write in two languages while keeping dates, places, and costs the same.
en.quick: Make a usable first version, then choose whether to add a feature.
en.skip: Choose “Make it work” or “Add a feature” and switch at any time; age does not decide the level.
en.source: Fictional notice L1: 社團體驗日 takes place on 2026/11/21 at 09:00 (Asia/Taipei), at 雲樓A室; 300 TWD per person. Reply whether attending by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei). Materials cost extra; their price is undecided. Neither activity nor venue has an approved English name.
en.prompt: Write short Chinese and English notices from these details. Make the time, place, price, and reply deadline easy to find. Keep activity and venue names in their original form and keep the extra materials cost.
steps: Select “Copy material and request” below.
Paste into a new AI conversation and send.
Return and check the points below. Ask AI to correct any errors.
en.expected: Chinese: 『社團體驗日』11/21 09:00於雲樓A室舉行，每人300 TWD；請於11/18 18:00前回覆。日期皆2026年，時間皆Asia/Taipei；材料另計、價格待確認。 English: Join 社團體驗日 at 雲樓A室 on 2026/11/21 at 09:00 (Asia/Taipei), 300 TWD per person. Reply by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei). Materials cost extra; the price is unconfirmed. All six fields agree, with no invented official names.

independent.task: Write a short notice in Chinese and English. Keep the information identical, preserve the event’s original name, and do not guess missing details.
independent.expected: Chinese preserves 12/03 15:00, B室, free admission, 12/01 12:00 registration deadline, and unknown materials. English example: 紙上散步 is at Room B on 2026/12/03 at 15:00 (Asia/Taipei), free of charge. Register by 2026/12/01 12:00 (Asia/Taipei). Materials provision is unconfirmed. independent.source:
Event: 紙上散步, 2026/12/03 at 15:00, classroom B, free.
Registration closes 2026/12/01 at 12:00. All times are Taipei time.
Materials provided: to confirm. There is no official English event name.

challenge.source: Fictional notice L1: 社團體驗日 takes place on 2026/11/21 at 09:00 (Asia/Taipei), at 雲樓A室; 300 TWD per person. Reply whether attending by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei). Materials cost extra; their price is undecided. Neither activity nor venue has an approved English name.
challenge.prompt: Turn the details into Chinese and English introductions to read aloud. Use three or four sentences per language and keep all known facts and unknowns.
challenge.expected: Both sound natural aloud and agree on the date, time, place, fee, deadline, and unknown materials fee.

checks: Both versions keep the same activity date, reply deadline, and 300 TWD per-person price.
Materials remains extra with their price unconfirmed, not included.
Keep original activity and venue names and Asia/Taipei in the full notice.

quiz.question: May L1's English version say materials are included?
choices: No; the source says extra cost with price undecided
Yes, because there is an admission fee
quiz.explanation: Rewriting may shorten wording but cannot change what is included.

en.outcome:
11/21 09:00一起參加「社團體驗日」，每人300 TWD。
Join 社團體驗日 on 11/21 at 09:00; 300 TWD per person.
(Excerpt; the full notice also includes the reply deadline and materials details.)
en.why: Tell friends in different languages about the same activity, keeping the facts while changing the wording.

classroom.task: Use the prepared result below. Choose one detail to change, edit it yourself, and explain how you checked it. You can use the change in step 2 as a starting point.
classroom.expected: Only tone and sentence length change. Both versions still give the same event details.

followup.prompt: Make the Chinese friendlier and use shorter English sentences. Keep all dates, places, costs, and unknowns.
followup.expected: Only tone and sentence length change. Both versions still give the same event details.

zh-Hant.title: 選自己的題目，做出一版
zh-Hant.goal: 選一件自己想做的事，完成一版、改一處、檢查一次。
zh-Hant.quick: 先做出一份可用的成果，再自己決定要不要加一個功能。
zh-Hant.skip: 自由選「先做出來」或「再加一個功能」，隨時可換；不按年齡分組。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構範例：週六14:00–16:00，3人在社團教室玩桌遊。
已有兩款桌遊與紙筆；需要準備清單及活動順序。
先介紹規則，再玩遊戲，最後留10分鐘收拾。
每款遊戲所需時間未提供，不用做網站或算預算。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請依資料做「已有／還要準備／活動順序」清單。未知時間要標示，不猜遊戲時長；補充物品列為建議。先給可用的第一版，再問我想改哪一處。
steps: 按下方「複製資料與要求」。
貼到 AI 的新對話，送出。
回來核對下方重點；有錯就請 AI 修正。
zh-Hant.expected: 已有：兩款桌遊、紙筆；還要準備可列建議，例如飲用水。順序：14:00開始介紹規則→依確認後的時長安排遊戲→15:50收拾→16:00結束。遊戲時長待確認，不虛構每款結束時間。

independent.task: 請先依我的資料做一版。缺少資訊就標出來，不要自行編造。
independent.expected: 先把方括號換成自己的內容，再送給 AI。完成後提出一項修改，用自己設定的方法檢查，保存新版。
independent.source:
我的題目：[填入你想做的事]
已知資料：[填入三件已確定的事]
希望得到：[例如清單、簡介或小網頁]
怎麼檢查：[填入一項檢查方式]

challenge.task: 讓第一次來的人也能跟上
challenge.source:
虛構範例：週六14:00–16:00，3人在社團教室玩桌遊。
已有兩款桌遊與紙筆；需要準備清單及活動順序。
先介紹規則，再玩遊戲，最後留10分鐘收拾。
每款遊戲所需時間未提供，不用做網站或算預算。
challenge.prompt: 依這份桌遊活動資料，加一段「第一次來怎麼開始」。不知道遊戲規則或一局多久，請標待確認，不要替遊戲編規則。
challenge.expected: 有清楚的集合、介紹與開始順序；遊戲規則及一局時間仍待確認。

checks: 成果有用到我提供的資料，沒有編造缺少的資訊。
我改了一項要求，其他正確資訊仍保留。
我能指出一項核對結果，並保存作品。

quiz.question: 怎樣的題目適合當第一個小作品？
choices: 我下週會用到，而且能先做出一個簡單版本
必須一次做完整套大型系統
一定得從指定品牌或專案選一個
quiz.explanation: 從熟悉、範圍小的需求開始，比較容易試用，也比較知道下一步想改什麼。

zh-Hant.outcome:
桌遊聚會｜已有兩款桌遊、紙筆。
14:00說明規則→遊戲時長待確認→15:50收拾→16:00結束。
zh-Hant.why: 把提問、修改與試用串起來，做一件你真的想用的東西。

classroom.task: 使用下方預備結果，自己決定改一處、動手修改，再說明怎麼檢查。可以從第 2 步的修改開始。
classroom.expected: 人數改成 5；需確認桌遊適用人數。時間、地點與最後 10 分鐘收拾不變。

followup.source: 參加人數由 3 人改成 5 人。
followup.prompt: 更新活動安排，列出還需要確認什麼。不要假設兩款桌遊都能讓五人一起玩。
followup.expected: 人數改成 5；需確認桌遊適用人數。時間、地點與最後 10 分鐘收拾不變。

en.title: Make something of your own
en.goal: Choose a task, make a first version, change one thing, and check it.
en.quick: Make a usable first version, then choose whether to add a feature.
en.skip: Choose “Make it work” or “Add a feature” and switch at any time; age does not decide the level.
en.source:
Fictional example: 3 people play board games in the club room on Saturday, 14:00–16:00.
Two board games and pen and paper are already available; need a preparation checklist and activity sequence.
Explain rules first, play, then leave 10 minutes for tidying up.
Game durations are not provided. No website or budget calculation is needed.
en.prompt: Make an “Already available / Prepare / Activity sequence” checklist from the data. Mark unknown times instead of inventing game durations; label additional items as suggestions. Give a usable first version, then ask what I want to change.
steps: Select “Copy material and request” below.
Paste into a new AI conversation and send.
Return and check the points below. Ask AI to correct any errors.
en.expected: Already available: two board games, pen and paper. Suggested preparation might include drinking water. Sequence: start explaining rules at 14:00 → play after confirming game durations → tidy up at 15:50 → finish at 16:00. Game durations are unknown; do not invent finish times for each game.

independent.task: Make a first version using my details. Point out missing information instead of inventing it.
independent.expected: Replace the bracketed text with your details before sending. Then request one change, use your chosen check, and save the new version.
independent.source:
My task: [something I want to do]
Known facts: [three confirmed facts]
Result I want: [for example, a checklist, introduction, or webpage]
How I will check it: [one check]

challenge.source:
Fictional example: 3 people play board games in the club room on Saturday, 14:00–16:00.
Two board games and pen and paper are already available; need a preparation checklist and activity sequence.
Explain rules first, play, then leave 10 minutes for tidying up.
Game durations are not provided. No website or budget calculation is needed.
challenge.prompt: Add “How to get started on your first visit” to this board-game plan. Mark unknown game rules and playing times “to confirm”; do not invent them.
challenge.expected: There is a clear arrival, introduction, and play sequence; game rules and playing times remain to confirm.

checks: The result uses my material without inventing missing facts.
I changed one requirement while keeping the other correct details.
I can show one check and save the result.

quiz.question: What makes a good first small project?
choices: Something I will use next week and can start with a simple version
It must be a complete large system
It must come from a fixed brand or project
quiz.explanation: A small, familiar need is easier to try out and gives you a clearer idea of what to improve next.

en.outcome:
Board-game meetup | Two games, pen and paper available.
14:00 explain rules → game durations to confirm → 15:50 tidy → 16:00 finish.
en.why: Combine asking, revising, and trying to make something you actually want to use.

classroom.task: Use the prepared result below. Choose one detail to change, edit it yourself, and explain how you checked it. You can use the change in step 2 as a starting point.
classroom.expected: The plan uses five people and asks about game capacity. The time, place, and final ten minutes for cleanup stay the same.

followup.source: The group grows from three people to five.
followup.prompt: Update the plan and list what we need to confirm. Do not assume both games support five players.
followup.expected: The plan uses five people and asks about game capacity. The time, place, and final ten minutes for cleanup stay the same.
